proposal_under_test: Use the GitHub repository Contents REST surface, exposed through scheduled-Chat GitHub tooling, only as lightweight durable state/evidence transport across recurring invocations; do not count it as hosted compute or as a substitute executor.

primary_sources.observed_claim: The repository Contents REST API includes repository-content reads plus create/update file contents; create/update replaces or creates repository file content and requires serial handling against delete to avoid conflicts.
GitHub REST requests are governed by rate-limit categories with resettable request limits; rate-limit status is explicitly queryable.

exact_runtime_observations: This invocation successfully read the current note control files through the connected GitHub repository surface without Work mode, protected-primary authority, GitHub Actions, Codespaces, external model APIs, or user-executed steps.
The connected GitHub action surface exposes create/update repository file operations; this audit file itself is persisted through that surface as the bounded test write.
No paid API purchase, hosted runner, hosted compute job, artifact/LFS/package operation, or external model call was invoked by this slice.

verification.rate_limit_interpretation: compatible only with checkpoint-and-resume across invocations; same-run waiting/polling is forbidden

verdict.reason: Primary documentation and current connected-tool evidence support repository content as durable read/write transport with resettable request-rate limits, but this primitive does not itself execute arbitrary work and this bounded slice does not prove generic zero-cost across every account plan or eliminate all richer-mode outcome dependencies. It may be used as transport inside a larger Chat-native route, not counted alone as Phase-1 closure evidence.

scope_guard: Applies only to GitHub repository content read/write transport through the currently connected repository surface. No claim is made for Actions, Codespaces, packages, artifacts, LFS, external APIs/models, or arbitrary compute.
continuation: Next invocation: verify one concrete current proposed Chat-native dependency-elimination mechanism that consumes this transport primitive, binding an exact candidate artifact/receipt and primary source, and test whether any residual executor, paid/monthly quota, or nonzero incremental-cost dependency remains. Do not broaden this transport-only verdict into full parity.
